The '''Kestel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Kestel system was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] as a replenishment point. Sometime before the capture of the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'', [[Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209/Legends|Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209]] proceeded on [[hyperlane GH972]] to rendezvous with [[Assault Fleet EM4]].<ref name="BI" />
